## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vitakkattika* ("The Triad 'Thought-conception, etc.'") constitutes section 7.6 of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final book of the canonical Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog; Nyanatiloka 2007]. Within the analytical architecture of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it is classified as the sixth triad chapter among the twenty-two primary matrix triads (*tika*) of the Abhidhamma classification system [Nyanatiloka 2007].
